name: Trazodone
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: CYP3A4-mediated oxidative cleavage forms active m-chlorophenylpiperazine (mCPP). Other metabolic routes are less well characterized; very little trazodone is excreted unchanged in urine.
